description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans client builder, verifying configuration validation, service registration, and startup behavior without requiring a full cluster. It also includes a no-op implementation of IGatewayListProvider for testing purposes.

classes.name: NoOpGatewaylistProvider
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of IGatewayListProvider used for testing Orleans client configuration without real network connectivity.

classes.name: ClientBuilderTests
classes.description: Contains various unit tests for the Orleans client builder, including configuration validation, service registration, and startup behavior.

methods.name: ClientBuilder_ClusterOptionsTest
methods.description: Verifies that the client requires valid ClusterId and ServiceId settings and fails if they are null.

methods.name: ClientBuilder_NoSpecifiedConfigurationTest
methods.description: Checks that a client can be created even if no specific configuration is provided.

methods.name: ClientBuilder_ThrowsDuringStartupIfNoGrainInterfacesAdded
methods.description: Ensures startup fails if no grain interfaces are registered, preventing misconfigured clients.

methods.name: ClientBuilder_ServiceProviderTest
methods.description: Tests that services can be registered and retrieved correctly within the client service provider.

methods.name: ClientBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfSiloBuildersAdded
methods.description: Verifies that configuring both silo and client in the same host throws a configuration exception.

methods.name: ClientBuilderWithHotApplicationBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfSiloBuildersAdded
methods.description: Checks that using the new Host.CreateApplicationBuilder API with both silo and client configuration throws an exception.
